verses.english: Linked Discourses 1.37
4. The Host of a Hundred Felicities
The Congregation
So I have heard.

verses.pali: ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṁ mahāvane mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṁ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi sabbeheva arahantehi;
verses.english: At one time the Buddha was staying in the land of the Sakyans, in the Great Wood near Kapilavatthu, together with a large Saṅgha of five hundred mendicants, all of whom were perfected ones.

verses.pali: dasahi ca lokadhātūhi devatā yebhuyyena sannipatitā honti bhagavantaṁ dassanāya bhikkhusaṅghañca.
verses.english: And most of the deities from ten solar systems had gathered to see the Buddha and the Saṅgha of mendicants.

verses.pali: Atha kho catunnaṁ suddhāvāsakāyikānaṁ devatānaṁ etadahosi:
verses.english: Then four deities of the Pure Abodes, aware of what was happening, thought:

verses.pali: “ayaṁ kho bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṁ mahāvane mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṁ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi sabbeheva arahantehi;
dasahi ca lokadhātūhi devatā yebhuyyena sannipatitā honti bhagavantaṁ dassanāya bhikkhusaṅghañca.
Yannūna mayampi yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkameyyāma; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato santike paccekaṁ gāthaṁ bhāseyyāmā”ti.
verses.english: “Why don’t we go to the Buddha and each recite a verse in his presence?”

verses.pali: Atha kho tā devatā—seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso samiñjitaṁ vā bāhaṁ pasāreyya pasāritaṁ vā bāhaṁ samiñjeyya; evameva—suddhāvāsesu devesu antarahitā bhagavato purato pāturahesuṁ.
verses.english: Then, as easily as a strong person would extend or contract their arm, they vanished from the Pure Abodes and reappeared in front of the Buddha.

verses.pali: Atha kho tā devatā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ aṭṭhaṁsu.
verses.english: They bowed to the Buddha and stood to one side.

verses.pali: Ekamantaṁ ṭhitā kho ekā devatā bhagavato santike imaṁ gāthaṁ abhāsi:
verses.english: Standing to one side, one deity spoke this verse in the Buddha’s presence:
“There’s a great congregation in the woods,
where hosts of gods have assembled.
We’ve come to this righteous congregation
to see the invincible Saṅgha!”

verses.pali: Atha kho aparā devatā bhagavato santike imaṁ gāthaṁ abhāsi:
verses.english: Then another deity spoke this verse in the Buddha’s presence:
“The mendicants there have immersion,
they’ve straightened their own minds.
Like a charioteer holding the reins,
the astute ones protect their senses.”

verses.pali: Atha kho aparā devatā bhagavato santike imaṁ gāthaṁ abhāsi:
verses.english: Then another deity spoke this verse in the Buddha’s presence:
“They snapped the post and snapped the cross-bar,
unstirred, they tore out Indra’s pillar.
They live pure and immaculate,
the young giants tamed by the Clear-eyed One.”

verses.pali: Atha kho aparā devatā bhagavato santike imaṁ gāthaṁ abhāsi:
verses.english: Then another deity spoke this verse in the Buddha’s presence:
“Anyone who has gone to the Buddha for refuge
won’t go to a plane of loss.
After giving up this human body,
they swell the hosts of gods.”
